guides.title: 光纖陣列被動對準：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Passive alignment of fiber arrays: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 被動對準依靠機械基準與統計容差。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Passive alignment depends on datums and statistical tolerances. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：被動對準依靠機械基準與統計容差。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測裝配後分布並与耦合容差窗口比較。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Passive alignment depends on datums and statistical tolerances. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare assembly distributions with coupling tolerance windows. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測裝配後分布並与耦合容差窗口比較」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare assembly distributions with coupling tolerance windows, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

sources.title: PI photonics alignment: test and assembly
AIM Photonics: Test, Assembly and Packaging

guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 光纖陣列被動對準：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Passive alignment of fiber arrays: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「設定機械與光學基準：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。晶片邊緣不一定與波導端點共線；裝配需定義可量測的基準轉換。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Set mechanical and optical datums: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. The chip edge need not coincide with waveguide endpoints; assembly requires measurable datum transforms. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜設定機械與光學基準：模型與設計：把圖面基準、視覺標記與模態中心標在同一圖上。
觀察站 2｜分配纖距公差：模型與設計：繪製通道序號對位置誤差並擬合斜率。
觀察站 3｜交付可製造性證據：量測與判別：比較跨批次合格比例與返工原因，標記未量測的公差。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Set mechanical and optical datums: model and design: Mark drawing datums, vision marks and mode centers in one coordinate map.
Observation station 2 | Allocate fiber-pitch tolerances: model and design: Plot position error by channel number and fit the slope.
Observation station 3 | Deliver manufacturability evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Compare cross-lot pass fractions and rework causes, marking unmeasured tolerances.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分配纖距公差：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付可製造性證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Allocate fiber-pitch tolerances: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver manufacturability evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「晶片切邊就是光學中心的精確基準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「只測中間纖芯足以驗證整排」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "A diced edge is an exact optical-center datum" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Testing the middle core validates the entire array" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 以公開光子研發與封裝機構為地理代表，討論V 溝幾何基準、纖芯偏心與公差堆疊如何由單一元件走向可量測、可封裝的系統。地圖沿用本學院矽光子課程的代表據點，並非此技術唯一發源地或所有文獻實驗位置。
courses.summaryEn: A public photonic research/packaging institution provides geographic context for translating V-groove datums, core eccentricity and tolerance stacks from a component into a measurable packaged system. The map uses the academy’s silicon-photonics reference location, not the sole invention site or every cited laboratory.

history.title: 從元件演示到可重現介面
history.titleEn: From component demonstration to reproducible interfaces
history.text: 公開研究與模擬教學逐步把V 溝幾何基準、纖芯偏心與公差堆疊連到基準、容差與封裝驗證。本課沿此方法脈絡安排作業，不宣稱單一機構獨創整項技術。
history.textEn: Public research and simulation tutorials connect V-groove datums, core eccentricity and tolerance stacks to reference conditions, tolerances and package validation. The course follows that methodological progression without assigning invention to one institution.

history.title: 跨元件與封裝的共同驗證
history.text: 相同光學性能需在固定、溫變與電性連接之後重新檢查；原始研究結果與量產資格是不同證據層級。
history.textEn: Recheck optical behavior after attachment, temperature change and electrical connection; research results and production qualification are different evidence levels.
